cards.title: and, or, not
cards.body: `and` is True only when both sides are True. `or` is True when at least one side is. `not` flips True and False.
cards.code:
print(True and False)
print(True or False)
print(not True)

hi.title: and, or, not
hi.body: `and` tabhi True hai jab dono side True hon. `or` True hai jab kam se kam ek side True ho. `not` True aur False ko palat deta hai.

cards.title: Combining conditions
cards.body: Join comparisons to describe a whole rule in one condition.

hi.title: Conditions jodna
hi.body: Comparisons ko jodkar ek hi condition mein poora rule likh sakte ho.

cards.title: Brackets make it clear
cards.body: Python works out `and` before `or`. Brackets make the order obvious, to you and to Python.

hi.title: Brackets se saaf hota hai
hi.body: Python `or` se pehle `and` solve karta hai. Brackets order ko saaf kar dete hain, aapke liye bhi aur Python ke liye bhi.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It calls everyone a teenager, even a 40-year-old. Which line is wrong?

bug.fix: With `or`, one true side is enough, and every age is `>= 13` or `<= 19`. Both must be true, so use `and`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Yeh sabko teenager bolta hai, 40 saal wale ko bhi. Kaunsi line galat hai?
hi.fix: `or` ke saath ek true side kaafi hai, aur har age ya toh `>= 13` hai ya `<= 19`. Dono true hone chahiye, isliye `and` use karo.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: 1900 divides by 4, but it also divides by 100, so y % 100 != 0 is False, and and needs both sides True.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: 1900 4 se divide hota hai, par 100 se bhi hota hai, isliye y % 100 != 0 False hai, aur and ko dono side True chahiye.

exercise.prompt: Read a year and print `leap` if it is a leap year, otherwise `common`. A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, except that years dividing by 100 are not, unless they also divide by 400.
exercise.promptHi: Ek saal padho aur agar woh leap year hai toh `leap` print karo, warna `common`. Saal leap year hota hai agar 4 se divide ho, par jo saal 100 se divide hote hain woh leap nahi hote, jab tak woh 400 se bhi divide na hon.
